DB::statement("
            UPDATE {$prefix}web_socket_dialogs d
            INNER JOIN {$prefix}user_departments ud ON ud.dialog_id = d.id
            SET d.owner_id = ud.owner_userid
            WHERE d.type = 'group'
              AND d.group_type = 'department'
              AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND ud.owner_userid > 0
              AND d.owner_id != ud.owner_userid
        ");

DB::statement("
            UPDATE {$prefix}web_socket_dialogs d
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT du.dialog_id, MIN(du.id) AS min_id
                FROM {$prefix}web_socket_dialog_users du
                WHERE du.userid > 0 AND du.bot = 0
                GROUP BY du.dialog_id
            ) first_du ON first_du.dialog_id = d.id
            INNER JOIN {$prefix}web_socket_dialog_users owner_du ON owner_du.id = first_du.min_id
            SET d.owner_id = owner_du.userid
            WHERE d.type = 'group'
              AND d.group_type = 'user'
              AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND d.owner_id = 0
        ");

DB::statement("
            INSERT INTO {$prefix}web_socket_dialog_users
                (dialog_id, userid, role, bot, important, last_at, created_at, updated_at)
            SELECT
                d.id,
                d.owner_id,
                1,
                COALESCE(u.bot, 0),
                CASE WHEN d.group_type IN ('user', 'all') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                CASE WHEN d.group_type IN ('user', 'department', 'all') THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END,
                NOW(3),
                NOW(3)
            FROM {$prefix}web_socket_dialogs d
            INNER JOIN {$prefix}users u ON u.userid = d.owner_id
            LEFT JOIN {$prefix}web_socket_dialog_users du
                ON du.dialog_id = d.id AND du.userid = d.owner_id
            WHERE d.type = 'group'
              AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND d.owner_id > 0
              AND du.id IS NULL
        ");

DB::statement("
            UPDATE {$prefix}web_socket_dialog_users du
            INNER JOIN {$prefix}web_socket_dialogs d ON d.id = du.dialog_id
            SET du.role = 1,
                du.important = CASE WHEN d.group_type IN ('user', 'all') THEN du.important ELSE 1 END
            WHERE d.type = 'group'
              AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND d.owner_id > 0
              AND du.userid = d.owner_id
              AND (du.role != 1 OR (d.group_type NOT IN ('user', 'all') AND du.important != 1))
        ");

DB::statement("
            UPDATE {$prefix}web_socket_dialog_users du
            INNER JOIN {$prefix}web_socket_dialogs d ON d.id = du.dialog_id
            SET du.role = 0
            WHERE d.type = 'group'
              AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND d.owner_id > 0
              AND du.role = 1
              AND du.userid != d.owner_id
        ");
